SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),MAX(RanDate),121) + ' 12:00:00 AM' as LastRunDate 
FROM REFUND.BATCH b
INNER JOIN REFUND.BATCHSTATUS S
ON B.BatchStatusId = S.BatchStatusId 
AND B.BATCHTYPE = 'MA/EGR'
AND S.BatchStatus = 'Complete'

SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CAST(MAX(RanDate) AS DATE))+' '+CONVERT(VARCHAR(11),FORMAT(MAX(RanDate) , 'hh:mm:ss tt')) as LastRunDate
FROM REFUND.BATCH b
INNER JOIN REFUND.BATCHSTATUS S
ON B.BatchStatusId = S.BatchStatusId 
AND B.BATCHTYPE = 'MA/EGR'
AND S.BatchStatus = 'Complete'

SELECT CONVERT(nvarchar,getdate()-1,101) + ' 11:59:59 PM' AS CurrentDate ,  CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CAST(RanDate AS DATE))+' '+CONVERT(VARCHAR(11),FORMAT(RanDate , 'hh:mm:ss tt'))  as CurrentDateME
FROM REFUND.BATCH where BatchId =@0

SELECT COUNT(1)  from Refund.Refund where BatchId=@BatchId  AND (PullInd  IS NULL OR PullInd='')

if not exists(SELECT TOP 1 1  from Refund.Refund where BatchId=@BatchId  AND (PullInd  IS NULL OR PullInd=''))
begin
EXEC [GENERIC].[Pr_UpdateEventLog] 2,3,1,'No records found to generate Auto Batch file.'
EXEC [GENERIC].[Pr_Update_Batch_Status] 
'[Refund].[Batch]',@BatchId,'Complete'
EXEC [GENERIC].[Pr_UpdateEventLog] 2,1,11,'Package for Refund completed.'
end

TO_TIMESTAMP('05/12/2022 11:59:59 PM' ,'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS PM')               AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT         JOIN (SELECT BLEI_CK, BLBL_DUE_DT, MAX(BLIV_CREATE_DTM) BLIV_CREATE_DTM                  FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE                  GROUP BY BLEI_CK, BLBL_DUE_DT                  ) MAXBLIV                  ON BLIV.BLEI_CK = MAXBLIV.BLEI_CK                  AND gv_RefundQuery.defaultValue:
'SELECT DISTINCT 
            'N' AS PDBL_ID,
            ' ' AS RECEIPT_REASON,
            ' ' AS PAYMENT_METHOD,
            SBSB.SBSB_ID, 
            ' ' AS BGBG_ID,
            GRGR.GRGR_ID,
            BLEI.BLEI_NET_ALLOC_SUSP,
            SBSB.SBSB_RECD_DT,
            NULL AS RECEIVED_DATE
  FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC  SBSB
       JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI
           ON     SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK
              AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'
              AND BLEI_NET_ALLOC_SUSP > 0
       JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK
       LEFT JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
       JOIN FACETS.AU_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC AU
           ON     SBSB.SBSB_ID = AU.SBSB_ID
              AND AU.SBSB_RETIRE_DT = SBSB.SBSB_RETIRE_DT
              AND AU.HIST_IMAGE_CD = 'A'
              AND EXISTS
                      (SELECT *
                         FROM FACETS.AU_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC S2
                        WHERE     AU.SBSB_ID = S2.SBSB_ID
                              AND AU.TXN1_ROW_ID = S2.TXN1_ROW_ID
                              AND AU.HIST_IMAGE_CD != S2.HIST_IMAGE_CD
                              AND AU.SBSB_RETIRE_DT != S2.SBSB_RETIRE_DT
            )  
WHERE SBSB.SBSB_RETIRE_DT != TO_DATE('1/1/1753', 'MM/DD/YYYY')
AND (GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%MCRWP0' OR GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%MCR000') 
AND TO_TIMESTAMP('05/12/2022 11:59:59 PM' ,'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS PM')>=CAST(TRUNC(AU.HIST_CREATE_DTM) AS DATE)+4 
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM FACETS.CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS RCPT
                WHERE RCPT_INPUT_SBSB_ID =SBSB.SBSB_ID
                AND (RCPT_CREATE_DTM >= TO_TIMESTAMP('05/12/2022 11:59:59 PM' ,'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS PM')-15)
  AND RCPT_RCPT_CD='P')   
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FACETS.CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS RCPT
WHERE RCPT_INPUT_SBSB_ID =SBSB.SBSB_ID AND RCPT.RCPT_RCPT_CD IN ('W') 
AND RCPT_CREATE_DTM = (SELECT MAX (RCPT_CREATE_DTM) FROM  FACETS.CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS RCPT1    
WHERE RCPT1.RCPT_INPUT_SBSB_ID =RCPT.RCPT_INPUT_SBSB_ID))
UNION
SELECT 
 'N' AS PDBL_ID,
            ' ' AS RECEIPT_REASON,
            ' ' AS PAYMENT_METHOD,
            SBSB.SBSB_ID, 
            ' ' AS BGBG_ID,
            GRGR.GRGR_ID,
            BLEI.BLEI_NET_ALLOC_SUSP,
            SBSB.SBSB_RECD_DT,
            NULL AS RECEIVED_DATE
FROM CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB  
JOIN CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK AND MEME.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK 
JOIN CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON MEME.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%PDP%'
JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEMD_MECR_DETL MEMD ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEMD.MEME_CK AND MEME.GRGR_CK = MEMD.GRGR_CK AND MEMD_EVENT_CD = 'DETH'
JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' AND BLEI_NET_ALLOC_SUSP > 0
JOIN (SELECT RCPT_INPUT_SBSB_ID, MAX(RCPT_CREATE_DTM) RCPT_CREATE_DTM 
                            FROM CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS WHERE RCPT_RCPT_CD = 'P' AND RCPT_STS IN ('01','91') 
                            GROUP BY RCPT_INPUT_SBSB_ID) RCPT  ON SBSB.SBSB_ID = RCPT.RCPT_INPUT_SBSB_ID
WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP('05/12/2022 11:59:59 PM' ,'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS PM') >= CASE WHEN (TRUNC(RCPT_CREATE_DTM) +15) > (MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT+4) THEN (TRUNC(RCPT_CREATE_DTM) +15) ELSE (MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT+4) END
UNION 
SELECT DISTINCT 
            'N' AS PDBL_ID,
            'ROTH' AS RECEIPT_REASON,
            ' ' AS PAYMENT_METHOD,
            SBSB.SBSB_ID, 
            ' ' AS BGBG_ID,
            GRGR.GRGR_ID,
            RCPT.RCPT_AMT,
            SBSB.SBSB_RECD_DT,
            NULL AS RECEIVED_DATE
FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
       JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
          ON SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK AND (GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%EGR%' OR GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%GRS%')
      JOIN FACETS.CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS RCPT 
          ON RCPT.RCPT_INPUT_SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID 
          AND RCPT.RCPT_INPUT_GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID
             AND RCPT.RCPT_MCTR_RSN = 'PGRS'
             AND RCPT.RCPT_STS =91
WHERE RCPT.RCPT_CREATE_DTM > TO_TIMESTAMP('05/12/2022 11:59:59 PM' ,'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS AM') 
  AND RCPT.RCPT_CREATE_DTM <= TO_TIMESTAMP('2015-01-15 09:27:47 AM' ,'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS AM') 
UNION 
SELECT  DISTINCT 
        RECEIPT_CODE,
        RECEIPT_REASON,
        PAYMENT_METHOD,
        SUBSCRIBER_ID,
        ' ' AS BGBG_ID,
        GROUP_ID AS GRGR_ID,
        RFD_AMOUNT,
        CHECK_NUMBER,
        RECEIVED_DATE 
    FROM AGP.LISR_DUMMYPAYMENTS_REFUNDS
UNION 
SELECT DISTINCT
        'F' AS RECEIPT_CODE,
        'RLIS' AS RECEIPT_REASON,
        'B' AS PAYMENT_METHOD,
        ' ' AS SUBSCRIBER_ID,
        BGBG.BGBG_ID,
        ' ' AS GRGR_ID,
        ABS(SUM(INSB.BLSB_PREM_SB)) AS RFD_AMOUNT,
        MAX(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT) AS CHECK_NUMBER,
        NULL AS RECEIVED_DATE 
    FROM FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG
         JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI
          ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BGBG.bgbg_id = 'GRS00119'
             AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B'
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL
           ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK
              AND BLBL.BLBL_SPCL_BL_IND <> 'C'
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV
           ON BLIV.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK 
              AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM BETWEEN  TO_TIMESTAMP('9999-12-31 12:00:00 AM' ,'YYYY-MM-DD  HH:MI:SS AM')  AND TO_TIMESTAMP('05/12/2022 11:59:59 PM' ,'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS PM')
              AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT
        JOIN (SELECT BLEI_CK, BLBL_DUE_DT, MAX(BLIV_CREATE_DTM) BLIV_CREATE_DTM
                 FROM FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE
                 GROUP BY BLEI_CK, BLBL_DUE_DT
                 ) MAXBLIV
                 ON BLIV.BLEI_CK = MAXBLIV.BLEI_CK
                 AND BLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM = MAXBLIV.BLIV_CREATE_DTM
                 AND BLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT = MAXBLIV.BLBL_DUE_DT
        JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB
           ON INSB.BLIV_ID = BLIV.BLIV_ID
              AND INSB.PDBL_ID = 'LIS'
              AND INSB.BLSB_PREM_SB < 0
              GROUP BY 
              BGBG.BGBG_ID'
